category: usenet provider (Dutch, unlimited plans and non-expiring blocks)

free_tier.stated: No free tier and no trial on the plans page read; the cheapest plan is EUR 4.49 a month.

egress.terms: Unlimited data on three plans of 10 Mbit/s, 50 Mbit/s and unlimited speed; non-expiring block quotas on a separate page

chaining: Block quotas from 150 GB to 1,100 GB that do not expire are listed on a separate page (third-party index); the plans are speed-tiered.

limits.value: 10 Mbit/s and 50 Mbit/s tiers, plus an unlimited-speed tier
10 connections on the 10 Mbit/s plan, 50 on the 50 Mbit/s plan

limits_note: 10 Mbit/s EUR 4.49 a month (EUR 40.95 a year); 50 Mbit/s EUR 7.55 a month (EUR 72.50 a year); unlimited speed EUR 8.35 a month (EUR 79.99 a year). Yearly prices are shown as a monthly equivalent of EUR 3.41, EUR 6.04 and EUR 6.67.
binding_note: Data is unlimited; the speed tier and its connection count bound a month.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the page offers an automatic-renewal or one-time payment choice and the payment form was not opened, so its fields are behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: A third-party index lists the Abavia backbone; the vendor page read does not state one.
confidence_note: Prices, retention and connections are from the vendor plans page read on 2026-11-03; the page is in Dutch.

evidence.proved: the cheapest plan is EUR 4.49 a month

evidence.quote: Spotnews is a Dutch Usenet provider with servers in the EU and retention of over eleven years. Alongside three subscription tiers with unlimited volume — from 10 Mbit/s up to unrestricted speed — there are non-expiring block quotas from 150 GB to 1,100 GB. All plans offer up to 50 connections, Abavia backbone.
evidence.proved: a third-party index lists blocks of 150 GB to 1,100 GB and the Abavia backbone

notes: Priced per month and speed tier; block prices were not read.
